notes:
Account snapshot: FoxTrail builds a low-latency decisioning layer for ad auctions and realtime personalization. Extremely latency and cost sensitive — margins depend on sub-100ms decisioning at scale. Customer has 3rd-party DSP integrations and needs deterministic tail latency for 1:many bidder requests.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2026-01-22: inbound MQL, quick discovery call w/ Avery (initial traffic profile + cost goals).
- 2026-02-02: technical deep-dive w/ Diego (runtime constraints, existing infra: EKS + private VPC).
- 2026-02-11: product demo (hosted API + dedicated options). Fireflies id ff_2026-02-11_rtz8k2.
- 2026-02-18: shared security questionnaire; they require SOC2 + SSO + KMS + audit logging — asked for sample audit log format.
- 2026-02-25: POC scoping call — agreed on 48h benchmark: mix of chat-like reranking calls and embeddings lookups; target 2k concurrent rps for lookups, 500 rps for reranking.
- 2026-03-01: sent perf config suggestions from Redwood Optimize (batching profiles, KV-prefetch, int8 quantization candidate list). Link to perf deck in Drive.
- 2026-03-04: security follow-up meeting; asked for residency options for EU customers and encryption-at-rest details.

Use-case & requirements summary (customer language / shorthand):
- Workloads: "reranker-heavy pipeline + embedding index lookups for candidate recall".
- Latency targets: P95 end-to-end decision < 50ms for reranking; P99 < 120ms. Embedding lookup 20ms P95 when served from cache.
- Throughput targets: sustained 2k lookup rps, bursting to 5k for peak auctions; reranking 200-600 rps depending on campaign.
- Cost sensitivity: target incremental infra cost < $0.002 per auction decision; heavy emphasis on batching/caching to reduce per-token billing.
- Model preferences: prefer trimmed Llama-2 derived open models or quantized variants; willing to try 4-bit/8-bit quantized weights if accuracy delta < 3% on reranker eval set.
- Routing/fallback: must have deterministic fallback to a smaller quantized model for overload scenarios; can route lower-tier traffic to hosted cheaper instances.
- Observability: need token-level latency/cost breakdown, per-route histograms, and alerting on perf regressions tied to eval prompts.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML integration (Okta), SOC2 required, KMS-managed keys, audit logs retained 1 year, options for EU data residency for ad data.

Customer quotes / call notes (verbatim snippets):
- "If p95 slips past 60ms we lose bids — that's revenue."
- "We can't accept opaque cost; need per-decision accounting for finance."
- SE note: accuracy vs quantization will be judged on A/B test on live traffic — tolerance is small.

POC scope (agreed):
- 2-week bench: provision Redwood Dedicated pool (2 x 8xA10G or equivalent), deploy quantized reranker + cached embedding nodes.
- Bench tasks: synthetic auction replay (1M auctions/day), live-sampled 1% traffic A/B for quality delta.
- Metrics: P50/P95/P99 latency, tokens/decision cost, throughput, model accuracy delta (reranker NDCG), cache hit ratio.

Open questions / blockers (sales/SE playbook):
- Procurement: need a clearer pricing commitment for dedicated capacity (monthly commit tiers). Procurement timeline ~ 6 weeks.
- Residency: confirm whether private plane (Redwood Private) required for EU GDPR-sensitive customer subsets.
- Perf: customer asked for earlier-run P95/P99 numbers on quantized models — SE to run internal microbench and share numbers by 2026-03-10.

Next steps (short):
- SE (Diego) to run focused microbench for int8 and int4 quantized reranker and share p95/p99 + throughput by 2026-03-10.
- Sales (Avery) to prepare dedicated pricing options and draft SOW for 48h benchmark.
- Security to deliver sample audit log format + KMS integration notes by next touch.

Notes tone: choppy, CRM shorthand, mix of verbatim lines and action items. Good candidate for Redwood Optimize upsell (quantization + batching playbooks) and Dedicated sale if perf numbers align with targets.
